title: [Bug] select() of a enum[] column with NULL entries in the array fails
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/discussions/12846
Originally posted by **ari-s** September 5, 2025 When select()-ing a column / table with enum[] where an entry of the array is `NULL` sqlalchemy fails, from my understanding in the parsing of the return value. selecting a simple/non-array enum column with Null entries works though. This is with a postgres-DB, unsure about other DBs I'm posting this here because the issue-tracker tells me to, but it very much looks to me like a bug. MWE (well, almost working, you need a postgres-server and a database in it) This example uses introspection, but it fails in the same way with manually writing the objects. ```python from sqlalchemy import text, Enum, Table, MetaData, select from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import ARRAY from sqlalchemy.engine import create_engine if 'pw' not in dir(): pw = input('password?: ') engine = create_engine(f'postgresql://postgres:{pw}@{server}/{database}') with engine.connect() as con: metadata = MetaData() con.execute(text( ''' DO $$ BEGIN CREATE TYPE my_enum AS ENUM ( 'foo', 'bar' ); EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN null; END $$; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS my_enum_table ( id serial, my_enum_column my_enum, my_enum_array my_enum[] ); INSERT INTO my_enum_table(my_enum_column, my_enum_array) VALUES (NULL, '{"foo", NULL, "bar"}'); CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.my_enum_array_view AS SELECT '{foo,NULL}'::public.my_enum[] AS my_enum_array; ''')) table = Table('my_enum_table', metadata, autoload_with=engine) # select() of the column works col_data_enum = con.execute( select(table.c['my_enum_column']) ).fetchall() # selecting the array fails though col_data_array = con.execute( select(table.c['my_enum_array']) ).fetchall() # selecting the whole table fails too data = con.execute( table.select() ).fetchall() print(data) ```
patch: ```diff diff --git a/lib/sqlalchemy/dialects/postgresql/array.py b/lib/sqlalchemy/dialects/postgresql/array.py index 96f6dc21a..7155921f5 100644 --- a/lib/sqlalchemy/dialects/postgresql/array.py +++ b/lib/sqlalchemy/dialects/postgresql/array.py @@ -464,7 +464,7 @@ class ARRAY(sqltypes.ARRAY[_T]): super_rp = process pattern = re.compile(r"^{(.*)}$") - def handle_raw_string(value: str) -> list[str]: + def handle_raw_string(value: str) -> Sequence[Optional[str]]: inner = pattern.match(value).group(1) # type: ignore[union-attr] # noqa: E501 return _split_enum_values(inner) @@ -485,10 +485,13 @@ class ARRAY(sqltypes.ARRAY[_T]): return process -def _split_enum_values(array_string: str) -> list[str]: +def _split_enum_values(array_string: str) -> Sequence[Optional[str]]: if '"' not in array_string: # no escape char is present so it can just split on the comma - return array_string.split(",") if array_string else [] + return [ + r if r != "NULL" else None + for r in (array_string.split(",") if array_string else []) + ] # handles quoted strings from: # r'abc,"quoted","also\\\\quoted", "quoted, comma", "esc \" quot", qpr' @@ -506,4 +509,4 @@ def _split_enum_values(array_string: str) -> list[str]: result.append(tok.replace("_$ESC_QUOTE$_", '"')) else: result.extend(re.findall(r"([^\s,]+),?", tok)) - return result + return [r if r != "NULL" else None for r in result] ```
